name: devtui-7d0e0c02-blind22-ots
instr:
# devtui: hunting 22 undocumented edits without a test suite

This is the small box of text utilities I keep in my terminal, and since the last sync a broad spread of the everyday things it does has gone wrong. My documents did not change and neither did the way I invoke it. The repository has received 22 separate undocumented edits.

Taking a document written in one notation and asking for it back in another is the loudest problem, and the failures are inverted: good documents are refused and bad ones are waved through. Asking for YAML out of JSON reports a failure for every well-formed document I try, from a two-key object to nested objects and lists, while a document that is only junk between braces is swallowed without a word of complaint. Asking for JSON out of TOML fails the same way on plain key-value pairs, tables and tables-of-tables, and because the YAML direction leans on that same work, asking for YAML out of TOML is doubly dead. Asking for TOML out of JSON fails on everything, including the empty object that used to give me empty text back. Asking for TOML out of YAML fails on every ordinary document, and conversely a bare scalar such as a lone quoted zero-zero, which cannot be written as TOML at all, is now reported a success. Asking for XML out of JSON fails for simple objects, nested objects, lists and the empty object alike, though genuinely malformed JSON is still refused there. Asking for tidied YAML back has the same flavour: a tiny document with two keys
